PART III

System Design Use Cases

第三部分：系统设计用例

Ninety percent of the functionality delivered now is better than 100% of it delivered never. —Brian Kernighan and P. J. Plauger

现在交付 90% 的功能，也好过永远不交付 100% 的功能。——Brian Kernighan 与 P. J. Plauger

Part III of this book covers some common system design use cases and examples, which we will work through together to build and scale on top of AWS cloud computing services. For all the use cases, we’ll start with figuring out the system requirements, then move to a deep dive into system components, and finally close the chapter with a deployment view on AWS with Day 0 architecture (minimum viable product for a startup with, say, one thousand customers) and Day N architecture (scaling to millions of customers). Along the way, we’ll discuss the bottlenecks that might occur in design, best practices for designing large-scale systems, and comparisons of similar AWS services.

本书第三部分涵盖一些常见的系统设计用例和示例，我们将一起走查，在 AWS 云计算服务之上构建并扩缩。对于所有用例，我们先从弄清系统需求开始，然后深入系统组件，最后以在 AWS 上的部署视图收尾：Day 0 架构（一个初创公司约一千个客户的最小可行产品）和 Day N 架构（扩缩到数百万客户）。在此过程中，我们会讨论设计中可能出现的瓶颈、设计大规模系统的最佳实践，以及类似 AWS 服务之间的对比。

We recommend following the Make It Work, Make It Right, Make It Fast principle, and all the chapters in Part III follow this philosophy. It’s good to be optimistic that one day our system will serve one billion active users, but you don’t have to build the system from day one to support this scale. The goal of huge scale should never hold you back from launching the product—just make sure the system is extensible enough so that if there is a need in the future, it can be evolved as new users are onboarded and new features are introduced. For example, the following amazon.com website screenshot shows the initial launch of the website—there was no point back then in thinking of how to make it work for a billion customers.

我们推荐遵循 Make It Work、Make It Right、Make It Fast 原则，第三部分的所有章节都遵循这一哲学。乐观地期待有朝一日我们的系统能服务十亿活跃用户是好事，但你不必从第一天起就把系统构建成支持这个规模。巨大规模的目标绝不应阻碍你上线产品——只要确保系统足够可扩展，以便未来有需要时，能随着新用户接入和新特性引入而演进。例如，下面这张 amazon.com 网站截图展示了网站最初上线时的样子——那时候去思考如何让它服务十亿客户毫无意义。

Other reasons for redesigning any system could be cost and operational maintenance, such as when Uber started with Amazon DynamoDB to build a ledger store but later moved to its custom-built storage solution, Docstore. The same principle applies

重新设计任何系统的其他原因可能是成本和运维维护，例如 Uber 最初用 Amazon DynamoDB 构建一个账本存储，后来迁移到它自研的存储方案 Docstore。同样的原则也适用

Page 373

while we figure out components in any system: the goal should always be to get the system out in the hands of the public and gather feedback. There is no win in overoptimizing the system if we never reach the goal of solving the customers’ problems and finally generating revenue from it; after all, everyone is in business to earn money from the designed system or help other people to do so (as with open source projects).

于我们弄清任何系统组件之时：目标始终应当是把系统交到公众手中并收集反馈。如果我们永远达不到解决客户问题、并最终从中产生收入的目标，那么过度优化系统毫无意义；毕竟，每个人做生意都是为了从所设计的系统中赚钱，或帮助别人做到这一点（开源项目亦是如此）。

Designing a URL Shortener Service

We explored the concept of DNS in Chapter 9, noting that it’s easier to remember a website’s URL than its IP addresses—but what about the long URLs? It’s easy to remember the root part of the URL (for example, learning.oreilly.com in https://learning.oreilly.com/library/view/system-design-on/9781098146887), but you can easily forget the long URL. We often embed links in text because that increases the readability.

我们在第 9 章探索了 DNS 的概念，注意到记住一个网站的 URL 比记住它的 IP 地址更容易——但那些长长的 URL 呢？URL 的根部分很容易记（例如 https://learning.oreilly.com/library/view/system-design-on/9781098146887 中的 learning.oreilly.com），但长长的 URL 很容易忘。我们常在文本中嵌入链接，因为那会提升可读性。

Another way of sharing long URLs is by shortening them. For example, LinkedIn automatically shortens any URL that is part of a post because this helps increase post readability and user interaction. In microblogging applications like Twitter (now known as X), there is a limit on the number of characters in a single post, so to reduce the length of your text, you can shorten any URLs via some URL shortener service such as TinyURL or Bitly and attach those to the post instead of the full-length versions.

分享长 URL 的另一种方式是把它们缩短。例如，LinkedIn 会自动缩短帖子中的任何 URL，因为这有助于提升帖子可读性和用户互动。在 Twitter（现称 X）这样的微博应用中，单条帖子的字符数有限，因此为缩短文本长度，你可以通过 TinyURL 或 Bitly 之类的短链接服务缩短任何 URL，并把短链接附到帖子上，而不是全长版本。

This chapter explores the design of a URL shortener service and discusses how to deploy the system on the AWS cloud. We’ll start our discussion with requirements gathering and expectations from the system. Later, we’ll jump into the details of the system.

本章探讨短链接服务的设计，并讨论如何把系统部署到 AWS 云上。我们从需求收集和对系统的期望开始讨论。之后，我们深入系统的细节。

System Requirements

You should have a clear goal in mind for the problem you need to solve. From there, the next step to design any system, big or small, is to gather the requirements. These requirements include:

你应当对要解决的问题有一个清晰的目标。在此基础上，设计任何系统（无论大小）的下一步都是收集需求。这些需求包括：

  • Why is this system needed? What is the business use case this system is solving?
    为什么需要这个系统？这个系统在解决什么业务用例？
  • Who are the users of this system? How many users?
    这个系统的用户是谁？有多少用户？
Page 377
  • Is there already a system that you can leverage instead of designing a new system from scratch? Systems like Bitly expose URL-shortening APIs to business customers, so why should we build our own system instead of using Bitly system APIs?
    是否已经有一个系统可以利用，而不必从头设计新系统？像 Bitly 这样的系统向企业客户暴露 URL 缩短 API，那么我们为什么要构建自己的系统，而不是使用 Bitly 系统的 API？
  • Is the system’s latency critical?
    系统的延迟是否关键？

Requirements lists can be huge, and generating them can be time-consuming, but this is a very important step. Many times in Parts I and II, we discussed how to compare two technologies and pick the best solution depending on your understanding of the business use case. It is not possible to weigh the pros and cons of your options if your requirements are not clearly defined. The requirements of any system are usually specified in two categories: functional requirements and nonfunctional requirements (NFRs).

需求清单可能很长，列出来也可能耗时，但这是非常重要的一步。在第一、第二部分中，我们多次讨论如何比较两种技术，并根据你对业务用例的理解挑选最佳方案。如果需求没有清晰定义，就不可能权衡各选项的利弊。任何系统的需求通常分为两类来描述：功能需求和非功能需求（NFR）。

Functional and Nonfunctional Requirements

Functional requirements are the functionalities or features that the system offers to the end users. The main expectations from a URL shortener service are simple:

功能需求是系统向最终用户提供的功能或特性。对短链接服务的主要期望很简单：

  • The system takes input as a long URL and return a shortened URL.
    系统以长 URL 作为输入，并返回一个缩短的 URL。
  • The short URL should redirect to the long URL when accessed by any user.
    当任何用户访问短 URL 时，它应重定向到长 URL。

Along with the most critical requirements, you can consider value-add requirements that can be nice to have from a customer’s perspective or helpful in deriving business value. Some of these include:

除了最关键的需求之外，你还可以考虑一些增值需求——从客户角度看这些是锦上添花，或有助于衍生业务价值。其中一些包括：

  • Custom URL creation support
    支持自定义 URL 创建
  • Analytics on the URL access patterns, such as the most popular URLs
    对 URL 访问模式的分析，例如最热门的 URL
  • Expiration for a URL so that the URL automatically expires and is no longer accessible after a fixed period
    URL 过期机制，使 URL 在固定期限后自动过期、不再可访问
  • Plug-in-based architecture to ensure extensibility
    基于插件的架构，以确保可扩展性
  • APIs exposed to third-party clients so that they can integrate their applications with our system
    向第三方客户端暴露 API，使它们能把自己的应用与我们的系统集成

We should always gather as many requirements as possible about what might be needed, but we shouldn’t get so caught up thinking about future expectations that we lose track of current expectations. The additional requirements will help us design our system in an extensible way so that new features can be added without needing to rearchitect the system.

我们应始终尽可能多地收集可能需要的需求，但也不应过度纠结于未来的期望，以至于忽略了当前的期望。这些附加需求将帮助我们以可扩展的方式设计系统，从而无需重新架构系统即可添加新特性。

Page 378

The other type of requirements is nonfunctional. NFRs determine the constraints the system operates on and don’t directly affect the user feature-wise, but they are important for ensuring the quality of system operations. Here are a few examples:

另一类需求是非功能的。NFR 决定系统运行所受的约束，不直接影响用户可见的功能，但它们对于确保系统运行质量很重要。下面是几个例子：

Security. To ensure the system is not exploited by bad actors.

安全（Security）。确保系统不被恶意分子利用。

High availability. To ensure a high uptime percentage in a year.

高可用（High availability）。确保一年中高正常运行时间百分比。

Observability. To ensure that appropriate metrics and alerts are in place for constant monitoring of system health.

可观测性（Observability）。确保有恰当的指标和告警，用于持续监控系统健康状况。

Low latency. For short URL creation and redirection.

低延迟（Low latency）。用于短 URL 创建和重定向。

Data stores. Should be durable and ensure correctness of the data for the expiration time configured for a URL. The data should reside in the system until the expiration time or until it is explicitly removed by a user.

数据存储（Data stores）。应持久，并确保 URL 所配置过期时间的数据正确性。数据应驻留在系统中，直到过期时间，或直到被用户显式删除。

Fault tolerance. Via mechanisms like retry handling.

容错（Fault tolerance）。通过重试处理等机制。

Interoperability in the system architecture. The system operates at high scale and can be broken into multiple subsystems, so how will different subsystems interact with one another?

系统架构中的互操作性。系统大规模运行，可拆成多个子系统，那么不同子系统将如何相互交互？

These requirements will help us make better decisions while designing the system. Another part of the requirements-gathering step is identifying the scale the system will operate on.

这些需求将帮助我们在设计系统时做出更好的决策。需求收集步骤的另一部分是确定系统将在多大规模上运行。

System Scale

Scale refers to the number of users or the traffic we’re expecting on the system. We should be able to answer questions such as:

规模指我们预期系统上的用户数量或流量。我们应当能回答诸如这样的问题：

  • What is the potential number of user requests per second (RPS) or queries per second (QPS) to generate a short URL?
    生成短 URL 每秒可能的用户请求数（RPS）或查询数（QPS）是多少？
  • How many user requests (or how much load on the system) for redirecting short URLs to long URLs? We should have clarity on both the average and peak load on the system.
    把短 URL 重定向到长 URL 的用户请求数（或系统上的负载）是多少？我们应对系统的平均负载和峰值负载都清楚。
  • Do we have any idea of the amount of storage required to store the data?
    我们是否清楚存储数据所需的存储量？
Page 379

Coming up with scale numbers can be tricky if you’re starting out fresh since you might not have 100% accurate data to base these numbers on. In these scenarios, it’s OK to make a fair assumption with a balance of not too little and not too much. Let’s move ahead with the following assumptions about our requirements:

如果你是全新起步，得出规模数字可能很棘手，因为你可能没有 100% 准确的数据作为这些数字的依据。在这些场景中，做一个不偏不倚的合理假设是可以的。让我们基于以下对需求的假设继续推进：

  • Generate short URL from long URL: 1,000 RPS
    从长 URL 生成短 URL：1,000 RPS
  • Short URL to long URL redirection: 20,000 RPS
    短 URL 到长 URL 的重定向：20,000 RPS
  • Average duration of URL persistence in system: one year
    URL 在系统中平均保留时长：一年

There are a lot of database solutions in the market. To decide which one is best for our use case, we need to consider another important parameter: total storage space required. Knowing this can help answer questions like:

市场上有很多数据库解决方案。要决定哪一个最适合我们的用例，我们需要考虑另一个重要参数：所需的总存储空间。知道这一点有助于回答诸如这样的问题：

  • What is the expected cost we’ll bear if we use Amazon DynamoDB or Amazon Aurora?
    如果使用 Amazon DynamoDB 或 Amazon Aurora，我们将承担的预期成本是多少？
  • Do we require data partitioning from the start?
    我们是否从一开始就需要数据分区？

Other considerations important for scale could be figuring out an instance type and number of instances for applications deployed on Amazon EC2 instances or memory requirements for AWS Lambda. It’s not easy to get the real numbers before putting the system in production and serving actual consumer traffic. Make fair assumptions and then improve further based on learnings.

对规模重要的其他考虑可能包括：为部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用确定实例类型和实例数量，或 AWS Lambda 的内存需求。在把系统投入生产、服务真实消费者流量之前，得到真实数字并不容易。做出合理假设，然后基于所学进一步改进。

One key consideration is system load testing; load testing helps you gain confidence that the system can perform as expected (the system is reliable) with increased traffic demands. Let’s discuss the storage space requirements next.

一个关键考虑是系统负载测试；负载测试帮助你获得信心：在流量需求增加时系统能按预期表现（系统是可靠的）。下面我们讨论存储空间需求。

Storage Space

The actual storage required will vary depending on the type of data storage solution we use because the data storage and access patterns are different for each database. An approximate calculation of the storage space will depend on the number of URLs, the lengths of the short URLs and long URLs, user metadata, and URL metadata such as expiration time and creation time. The number of URLs generated in a year can be derived from assumed traffic of 1,000 RPS:

实际所需存储会因我们使用的数据存储方案类型而异，因为每个数据库的数据存储和访问模式都不同。存储空间的近似计算取决于 URL 数量、短 URL 和长 URL 的长度、用户元数据，以及 URL 元数据（如过期时间和创建时间）。一年生成的 URL 数量可以从假设的 1,000 RPS 流量推导出来：

Total URLs in one year = (1,000 requests/second) x 60 (per minute) x 60 (per hour) x 24 (per day) x 365 (per year) ~ 31.53 billion

Before moving further along on storage calculation, we need to figure out the ideal length of a short URL. The length should be such that the system doesn’t run out of unique short URLs and should be able to support the required scale of 31.5 billion unique URLs per year. In Chapter 9, we discussed IPv6 addresses as a replacement for

在进一步计算存储之前，我们需要弄清短 URL 的理想长度。该长度应使系统不会用完唯一短 URL，并能支持每年 315 亿个唯一 URL 的所需规模。在第 9 章，我们讨论过 IPv6 地址作为

Page 380

IPv4 addresses because the world is running out of unique IP addresses. We definitely don’t want this kind of problem to occur in our URL shortener system, so the length of the URL should be calculated with the proper considerations from the beginning. You might suggest a length of 12 or 15 to be on the safe side, but that defeats the purpose of shortening the URL.

IPv4 地址的替代方案，因为世界上唯一 IP 地址即将耗尽。我们绝不希望这种问题发生在短链接系统中，因此 URL 长度从一开始就应经过恰当考虑来计算。为保险起见你可能建议长度为 12 或 15，但那样就违背了缩短 URL 的初衷。

We can think about generating a short URL from the numbers 0−9, as well as the letters a–z and A–Z. What is the maximum number of unique URLs generated for a given length with these 62 unique characters?

我们可以考虑用数字 0–9 以及字母 a–z 和 A–Z 生成短 URL。用这 62 个唯一字符，给定长度最多能生成多少个唯一 URL？

Length(1) = 62^1 = 62
Length(6) = 62^6 = 56.8 billion
Length(7) = 62^7 = 3.5 trillion
Length(8) = 62^8 = 218.3 trillion

We can see based on these calculations that the URL system can support the required scale with a URL length of greater than or equal to 6. Considering future scale, we can finalize the URL length as 7.

从这些计算可以看出，URL 长度大于等于 6 时，URL 系统就能支持所需规模。考虑到未来规模，我们把 URL 长度定为 7。

Now, let’s go back to our original question: what is the required storage space? Considering a simple database schema of storing short URLs, long URLs, expiration times, and metadata, we can calculate our storage needs as follows:

现在回到最初的问题：所需存储空间是多少？考虑一个存储短 URL、长 URL、过期时间和元数据的简单数据库 schema，我们可以如下计算存储需求：

Short URL (7 characters) = 7 bytes
Average long URL (100 characters) = 100 bytes
Expiration date (long) = 8 bytes
Average metadata (user IP, user preferences, etc.) = 1 KB
Total ~ 1150 bytes

For simplicity, let’s take 1 KB as the storage requirement for a single URL:

为简单起见，我们把单个 URL 的存储需求取为 1 KB：

Total storage for one year = 31.53 billion x 1 KB = 29.37 TB

The system has additional storage requirements, such as cache to improve query performance, analytics data, and user authentication database (which can be required if the system offers additional capabilities to logged-in users, such as custom URL creation, view analytics, etc.).

系统还有额外的存储需求，例如用于提升查询性能的缓存、分析数据，以及用户认证数据库（如果系统向登录用户提供自定义 URL 创建、查看分析等附加能力，就可能需要它）。

Page 381

With all these requirements in mind, let’s move forward with the design of a URL shortener service.

考虑到所有这些需求，我们继续推进短链接服务的设计。

Starting with the Design

We mentioned in the requirements-gathering section that we shouldn’t think too far ahead because we don’t know what our system will look like in the future or what new features we might introduce to evolve with the market. We should try to keep our systems open-ended so that we can introduce new features with ease when they are actually needed. Figure 14-1 shows the most basic architecture and user interactions for the URL shortener service to meet the defined functional requirements. The users create a short URL corresponding to a long URL using the URL shortener service and then use the same short URL in the web browser (or terminal) to access the URL. The URL shortener service figures out the long URL corresponding to the short URL and redirects the request.

我们在需求收集部分提到过，不应想得太远，因为我们不知道未来系统会是什么样子，也不知道会引入什么新特性来随市场演进。我们应尽量让系统保持开放式，以便在真正需要时能轻松引入新特性。图 14-1 展示了短链接服务为满足已定义功能需求而采用的最基本架构和用户交互。用户使用短链接服务创建一个与长 URL 对应的短 URL，然后在 Web 浏览器（或终端）中使用同一个短 URL 来访问该 URL。短链接服务弄清短 URL 对应的长 URL，并把请求重定向过去。

The first thing we need to figure out for the design is how a short URL can be generated from a long URL so that it can be optimally stored, supporting faster user-lookup queries.

设计中我们首先要弄清的是：如何从长 URL 生成短 URL，使其能被最优存储，并支持更快的用户查询。

URL Shortening Algorithm

A long URL can be shortened into a short URL via different algorithms. We’ll discuss how some of them can fit our system use case, starting with hashing.

长 URL 可以通过不同算法缩短为短 URL。我们将讨论其中一些如何适配我们的系统用例，从哈希开始。

Hashing

Hashing seems to be a viable solution to solve this problem: using a hash function such as MD5, which takes a long URL as input and returns a hash of this long URL as output. The length of the generated hash can be greater than 7, so the system should

哈希似乎是解决这个问题的可行方案：使用诸如 MD5 这样的哈希函数，以长 URL 作为输入，返回该长 URL 的哈希作为输出。生成的哈希长度可能大于 7，因此系统应

Page 382

trim the generated hash to a reduced length. This solution is easy to implement but it has one problem: collision. Two different long URLs could possibly generate the same hash, and even if the hash is different, the truncated length could be the same. At large scale, this can become a frequent problem, making short URL generation a bottleneck.

把生成的哈希裁剪到缩短后的长度。这个方案容易实现，但有一个问题：冲突。两个不同的长 URL 可能生成相同的哈希；即使哈希不同，裁剪后的长度也可能相同。在大规模下，这会成为一个频繁出现的问题，使短 URL 生成成为瓶颈。

There are different methods of handling collisions: one possible solution is to take some other set of characters instead of truncating to the first 7 characters. The hash-generation approach also requires a data store lookup (or multiple lookups in the case of collisions), which adds extra latency to the operation, as shown in Figure 14-2.

处理冲突有不同方法：一种可能的方案是取另一组字符，而不是裁剪前 7 个字符。哈希生成方式还需要一次数据存储查找（在冲突情况下可能是多次查找），这给操作增加了额外延迟，如图 14-2 所示。

In short, the hashing solution is not so perfect for our system requirements. Let’s think about an option that would avoid the collisions and perhaps also avoid the database lookups to make operation faster.

简而言之，哈希方案对我们的系统需求并不那么完美。让我们想一个能避免冲突、或许还能避免数据库查找、从而让操作更快的方案。

Unique ID generation

A key point to consider here is that the long URL and short URL don’t have to be related—this would essentially be a unique ID generation system, which can map the generated ID to a long URL.

这里要考虑的一个关键点是：长 URL 和短 URL 不必相关——这本质上就是一个唯一 ID 生成系统，可以把生成的 ID 映射到一个长 URL。

Let’s discuss a few approaches for generating unique IDs. The ID can be as simple as a counter incremented every time a new request is received from the users or a feature like AUTO_INCREMENT from a database. If the system itself (without the involvement of the database) handles the ID generation, we can be sure of solving the problems of both collision handling and avoiding database lookups. Think of it as a server initializing a counter value with “1” and then incrementing it every time a new request arrives. The mapping can be stored to a database, and then the short URL is returned to the user, as shown in Figure 14-3.

我们讨论几种生成唯一 ID 的方法。ID 可以简单到就是一个计数器，每次从用户收到新请求时加一，或像数据库的 AUTO_INCREMENT 那样的特性。如果系统自己（不借助数据库）处理 ID 生成，我们就有把握同时解决冲突处理和避免数据库查找这两个问题。可以把它想象成：一台服务器把计数器初始化为“1”，然后每次新请求到达时加一。映射可以存储到数据库，然后短 URL 返回给用户，如图 14-3 所示。

Page 383

The sequence of alphanumeric characters from 0 to 9, a to z, and A to Z when used for encoding is referred to as base62 encoding. Note that when using base62 encoding on the counter values (decimal numbers), the short URL will be unique but not always of length 7. For example:

由 0 到 9、a 到 z、A 到 Z 组成的字母数字序列用于编码时，称为 base62 编码。注意，对计数器值（十进制数字）使用 base62 编码时，短 URL 会唯一，但并不总是长度 7。例如：

Base62(1) = 1
Base62(10) = A
Base62(61) = z
Base62(62) = 10
Base62(63) = 11
Base62(1000001) = 4C93

To ensure the length is always 7, we can append random characters to the generated base62 value from other character set, which is mutually exclusive of the alphanumeric set (say, _, #, etc.).

为确保长度始终为 7，我们可以从另一组与字母数字集互斥的字符集（例如 _、# 等）中取随机字符，追加到生成的 base62 值之后。

We haven’t decided on the maintenance of the counter value. The simple solution is to maintain a global counter variable in our application, which is updated after every new short URL generation. But there can be multiple machines on which the application is running, which can lead to a duplicate counter value. Even if there is a single machine, it has a risk of going down, which would make the counter value again start from zero.

我们还没有决定如何维护计数器值。简单的方案是在应用中维护一个全局计数器变量，每次生成新短 URL 后更新它。但应用可能运行在多台机器上，这会导致重复的计数器值。即使只有一台机器，它也有宕机风险，那会使计数器值又从零开始。

To solve this, we can consider maintaining this global counter in a database. This way, it solves the problem of a single machine going down (the counter is not initialized to zero every time) or multiple machines being responsible for URL generation (duplicate counter values across the machines). However, it can also cause issues because we can’t allow multiple application threads to access the counter at the same

为解决这个问题，我们可以考虑把这个全局计数器维护在数据库中。这样，它解决了单机宕机（计数器不会每次都初始化为零）或多台机器负责 URL 生成（机器间计数器值重复）的问题。然而，它也可能带来问题，因为我们不能允许多个应用线程同时访问计数器，

Page 384

time in order to avoid race conditions, and if we apply a lock (a single machine reads and updates the value), that will increase operation latency.

以避免竞态条件；而如果我们加锁（单台机器读取并更新值），又会增加操作延迟。

Let’s simplify the entire architecture further to ensure optimal application performance. We can assign additional responsibility to the system of pregenerating the short URLs since they are not dependent on the long URL. This way, multiple machines can utilize the pregenerated IDs (short URLs), solving all the bottlenecks. Our URL shortener service consists of an additional component responsible for pregeneration of short URLs and keeping them in memory for faster access. An important decision to make here is whether we give this additional responsibility to our URL shortener service or host it as an independent service. (We discussed monolith and microservice architecture in Chapter 8 and the benefits associated with each.)

让我们进一步简化整个架构，以确保应用性能最优。我们可以让系统承担预生成短 URL 的额外职责，因为短 URL 并不依赖长 URL。这样，多台机器就可以利用预生成的 ID（短 URL），解决所有瓶颈。我们的短链接服务包含一个额外组件，负责预生成短 URL 并把它们保存在内存中以便更快访问。这里要做的一个重要决定是：我们把这个额外职责交给短链接服务，还是把它托管为一个独立服务。（我们在第 8 章讨论过单体和微服务架构以及各自的好处。）

A single component will ensure comparatively less hardware cost (at least in the beginning) and less latency since there’s no requirement for network calls between the services. What you need to consider in order to make the decision here is what value you’re getting if this is an independent component instead of hosted as part of the main application. A separate ID generation or key generation service (KGS) can be beneficial for other use cases, and this is an independent responsibility that doesn’t have to be tied to the URL shortener service. Given this, we’ll go with the idea of hosting a separate service with the responsibility for generating unique keys and passing those on to our URL shortener service when requested, as shown in Figure 14-4.

单一组件将确保硬件成本相对较低（至少在初期）、延迟较小，因为服务之间无需网络调用。做这个决定时你需要考虑的是：如果它是一个独立组件、而不是作为主应用的一部分托管，你能获得什么价值。一个独立的 ID 生成或密钥生成服务（KGS）对其他用例也可能有好处，而且这是一项独立职责，不必与短链接服务绑定。鉴于此，我们采用这样的思路：托管一个独立服务，负责生成唯一密钥，并在被请求时把这些密钥传给我们的短链接服务，如图 14-4 所示。

An additional analytics pipeline is included in the architecture. The URL shortener service publishes the events of user activity to the queue, and the analytics pipeline takes care of analyzing and offering insights on the data.

架构中还包含一条额外的分析管道。短链接服务把用户活动事件发布到队列，分析管道负责分析数据并提供洞见。

Page 385

Now, let’s look at the KGS in more detail.

现在我们更详细地看看 KGS。

Key generation service

The KGS has a simple responsibility of providing unique IDs when requested by our URL shortener service. To ensure traffic control on the KGS as well as make the URL shortener system more efficient, the operation can offer a list of IDs—say, one thousand in a single operation—and the URL shortener service can re-request once these IDs are exhausted. Let’s dig a little deeper into how the KGS works: how should these unique IDs be generated?

KGS 的职责很简单：在短链接服务请求时提供唯一 ID。为确保 KGS 上的流量可控、并让短链接系统更高效，该操作可以一次提供一批 ID——比如一次一千个——短链接服务在这些 ID 用完后再重新请求。我们稍微深入一下 KGS 如何工作：这些唯一 ID 应如何生成？

We can consider using the database’s auto-increment feature, such as MySQL’s AUTO_INCREMENT or PostgreSQL’s SERIAL or SEQUENCE. This functionality is applicable for a leader instance (if there are multiple database instances), and it can become a single point of failure for maintenance of IDs, hampering overall system availability. Further, implementing this feature becomes very hard to do in the case of multi-instance database setup, such as horizontally scalable NoSQL databases. We can take inspiration from Flickr’s architecture, which uses MySQL’s auto-increment feature with a REPLACE INTO query to get a globally unique new ID on every new query:

我们可以考虑使用数据库的自增特性，例如 MySQL 的 AUTO_INCREMENT 或 PostgreSQL 的 SERIAL 或 SEQUENCE。这个功能适用于 leader 实例（如果有多个数据库实例），而它会成为 ID 维护的单点故障，妨碍整体系统可用性。此外，在多实例数据库设置（例如可水平扩缩的 NoSQL 数据库）的情况下，实现这个功能会非常困难。我们可以从 Flickr 的架构中汲取灵感，它使用 MySQL 的自增特性配合 REPLACE INTO 查询，在每次新查询时获得一个全局唯一的新 ID：

CREATE TABLE `Tickets64` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment,
  `stub` char(1) NOT NULL default '',
  PRIMARY KEY  (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `stub` (`stub`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

REPLACE INTO Tickets64 (stub) VALUES ('a');
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID();

To increase system availability and avoid a single point of failure, two database servers are used, starting with an even and odd number and offset as 2 to avoid collision:

为提高系统可用性并避免单点故障，使用两台数据库服务器，分别从偶数和奇数开始、步长为 2 以避免冲突：

TicketServer1:
auto-increment-increment = 2
auto-increment-offset = 1

TicketServer2:
auto-increment-increment = 2
auto-increment-offset = 2

Further regular snapshots should be taken of these two databases to ensure that a backup is always kept in case of any fatal scenarios. Since only a single row is maintained within a table, we can be sure that the server will not run out of storage space.

此外，应对这两个数据库定期做快照，以确保在任何致命场景下始终保留备份。由于表内只维护单行，我们可以确信服务器不会耗尽存储空间。

Figure 14-5 shows the interaction of the KGS with ticket servers for ID generation.

图 14-5 展示了 KGS 与 ticket 服务器在 ID 生成时的交互。

Page 386

The two ticket servers generate even and odd IDs, respectively, but this management overhead will increase if the ticket servers are deployed in multiple regions instead of just one. One potential solution to ensure uniqueness across regions could be adding a data center prefix to the short URL, such as a 1 for us-east-1, 2 for eu-west-1, and so on, making the URL eight characters instead of seven.

这两台 ticket 服务器分别生成偶数和奇数 ID，但如果 ticket 服务器部署在多个区域而非仅一个，这种管理开销会增加。确保跨区域唯一性的一个潜在方案是给短 URL 加一个数据中心前缀，例如 us-east-1 用 1、eu-west-1 用 2，依此类推，使 URL 变成 8 个字符而非 7 个。

In 2010, X proposed another approach for generating 64-bit unique IDs: Snowflake. Snowflake can generate 4,096 unique IDs per millisecond with a combination of timestamp (41 bits for epoch milliseconds timestamp), machine identifier number (10 bits, giving us up to 1,024 machines), and sequence number (12 bits for local counter per machine). The remaining 1 bit is a signed bit always set to 0. This approach won’t work directly for our URL shortener because the system always requires a 7-character-length string, but implementation can be built using a similar concept. X used Snowflake because of the requirement for sorting and ensuring ordering guarantees. The URL shortener system does not require creating IDs based on timestamp, so we’re free to choose an approach that’s easy to implement and maintain the uniqueness.
2010 年，X 提出了另一种生成 64 位唯一 ID 的方法：Snowflake。Snowflake 每毫秒可生成 4,096 个唯一 ID，组合了时间戳（41 位 epoch 毫秒时间戳）、机器标识号（10 位，最多 1,024 台机器）和序列号（12 位，每台机器本地计数器）。剩下 1 位是符号位，始终设为 0。这种方法不能直接用于我们的短链接服务，因为系统始终要求 7 字符长度的字符串，但可以用类似概念来实现。X 使用 Snowflake 是因为需要排序并保证顺序。短链接系统不要求基于时间戳创建 ID，因此我们可以自由选择一种易于实现并维护唯一性的方法。

The KGS can be extended to support multiple types of key generation based on client input in the API or client onboarding configuration. This makes the KGS a single system for generating any kind of identifier. Let’s now discuss the APIs that need to be supported by the URL shortener service.

KGS 可以扩展为根据 API 中的客户端输入或客户端接入配置，支持多种类型的密钥生成。这使 KGS 成为一个可生成任何种类标识符的单一系统。现在我们讨论短链接服务需要支持的 API。

System APIs

APIs help clients integrate with the system to make use of supported functionalities. The URL shortener service should support two main APIs: creating a short URL and retrieving a long URL from a short URL. The following code snippet shows an API signature for creating short URLs:

API 帮助客户端与系统集成，以使用所支持的功能。短链接服务应支持两个主要 API：创建短 URL 和从短 URL 检索长 URL。以下代码片段展示了创建短 URL 的 API 签名：

POST /v1/createShortUrl
{
    longUrl,
    customUrl,
    expiry,
    userMetadata
}
Page 387

The longUrl parameter is mandatory in API requests for generating a short URL. The additional attributes are added to support other functionalities of the application:

在生成短 URL 的 API 请求中，longUrl 参数是必填的。附加属性用于支持应用的其他功能：

customUrl. Helpful if the user wants to generate a custom URL instead of a random 7-character string. To handle this parameter, the URL shortener service will directly check in the database if the custom URL is already created, and if not, mapping of the custom URL to the long URL will be stored in the database.

customUrl。如果用户想生成一个自定义 URL，而不是随机的 7 字符串，这个参数会有用。为处理这个参数，短链接服务会直接在数据库中检查该自定义 URL 是否已创建；如果没有，就把自定义 URL 到长 URL 的映射存入数据库。

expiry. Enables users to specify a custom expiration for the URL instead of what is defined by the system.

expiry。让用户能为 URL 指定自定义过期时间，而不是使用系统定义的过期时间。

userMetadata. Used to gather extra information about the user, such as IP address, geographical location, and browser, which helps drive analytics.

userMetadata。用于收集关于用户的额外信息，例如 IP 地址、地理位置和浏览器，这有助于推动分析。

It’s possible that the same custom URL could be created by multiple users. Amazon DynamoDB’s default PutItem behavior is to update the item if the primary key already exists, but this is not a valid option for the URL shortener system. The PutItem request should contain a condition expression to fail the request for the same custom URL.
同一个自定义 URL 有可能被多个用户创建。Amazon DynamoDB 默认的 PutItem 行为是：如果主键已存在就更新该 item，但这对短链接系统不是一个有效选项。PutItem 请求应包含一个条件表达式，使得对相同自定义 URL 的请求失败。

The response of the API can be either success or failure. You might remember our discussion of HTTP status codes from Chapter 6—the status codes are helpful for determining the kind of HTTP response the client has received from the server. We should define proper mechanisms for both responses so that the clients can understand the response in failure scenarios and take any further actions, such as retry. The failures can be due to invalid parameters from the client side or some issue at the backend application.

API 的响应可以是成功或失败。你可能还记得我们在第 6 章对 HTTP 状态码的讨论——状态码有助于判断客户端从服务器收到的是哪种 HTTP 响应。我们应为两种响应都定义恰当的机制，使客户端在失败场景下能理解响应并采取任何进一步动作，例如重试。失败可能是由于客户端侧参数无效，或后端应用的某些问题。

Here is an example of a successful response:

下面是一个成功响应的例子：

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
    "shortUrl": "https://oreil.ly/SystemDesignOnAWS"
}

Here is an example of a failed response:

下面是一个失败响应的例子：

HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{
    "error": "An error occurred while processing your request"
}
Page 388

As a user creates a short URL and shares it with others or accesses it themself, the API request and response could look something like this:

当用户创建一个短 URL 并分享给他人、或自己访问它时，API 请求和响应可能是这样：

GET v1/getLongUrl
{
    shortUrl,
    userMetadata
}

Here is the successful response:

下面是成功响应：

HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/system-design-on/9781098146887

And here is the failed response:

下面是失败响应：

HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{

Let’s discuss any additional considerations before moving on to the AWS components we will use to deploy the system in production.

在转向我们将用于把系统部署到生产环境的 AWS 组件之前，我们先讨论一些额外考虑。

System Considerations

By this point, we’ve proposed two services in the architecture: the URL shortener service and the KGS for supporting end-to-end functionality. The URL shortener service is responsible for short URL generation as well as redirection. The APIs are simple enough to be supported by a single system, but the traffic patterns are quite different for both APIs; the traffic for URL redirection will be much higher than for URL generation.

到目前为止，我们在架构中提出了两项服务：短链接服务和用于支撑端到端功能的 KGS。短链接服务负责短 URL 生成以及重定向。这些 API 足够简单，可由单一系统支持，但两个 API 的流量模式却大不相同；URL 重定向的流量将远高于 URL 生成的流量。

Imagine a celebrity generating a short URL and sharing it with followers on social media platforms: all of their followers will try to access the URL, increasing overall system traffic. In these kinds of scenarios, we recommend starting with a single system and then evolving if traffic handling becomes a problem.

想象一位名人生成一个短 URL 并在社交媒体平台上分享给粉丝：他们所有的粉丝都会尝试访问该 URL，从而增加系统整体流量。在这类场景中，我们建议从单一系统开始，然后在流量处理成为问题时再演进。

Separating a system into two components can come with extra overhead, such as a database being accessed from two separate services. The URL shortener service will have both read and write use cases, whereas the URL redirect service will have read use cases on the database. It is generally not a good idea for two services to directly interact with a single database; the most robust solution is to expose the database operations via another service that is responsible for handling all database operations along with cache maintenance. We’ll also need to finalize the database choice, given the wide variety of database solutions available on the market.

把一个系统拆成两个组件可能带来额外开销，例如数据库被两个独立服务访问。短链接服务将同时有读和写的用例，而 URL 重定向服务在数据库上只有读用例。两个服务直接与同一个数据库交互通常不是好主意；最健壮的方案是通过另一个服务暴露数据库操作，由它负责处理所有数据库操作以及缓存维护。鉴于市场上数据库方案种类繁多，我们还需要最终确定数据库选择。

Database Selection

Multiple factors are involved in selecting the perfect database for a specific use case. We explored different types of databases and compared them in Chapters 2, 3, and 10. Figure 3-4 explains how to navigate through the database choices and finalize on a particular database. Begin with the data type and then look for the needed query patterns by the application. Let’s consider the URL shortener service first.

为特定用例选择完美数据库涉及多个因素。我们在第 2、3、10 章探索了不同类型的数据库并做了比较。图 3-4 解释了如何在数据库选择中导航并最终确定某个数据库。从数据类型开始，然后寻找应用所需的查询模式。我们先考虑短链接服务。

URL shortener service. For the URL shortener service, the data is structured, and the expected query patterns are as follows:

短链接服务。对于短链接服务，数据是结构化的，预期的查询模式如下：

  • Get a long URL for a specific short URL.
    根据特定短 URL 获取长 URL。
  • Get all URLs for a user in a specific period of time. This is a secondary query pattern and is only required for logged-in users.
    获取某个用户在特定时间段内的所有 URL。这是次要查询模式，仅登录用户需要。

These query patterns can be solved by both relational and nonrelational databases, and you can choose based on previous expertise. We recommend a logical partitioning strategy from the start if you choose a relational database for deployment. In the context of this chapter, we’ll go ahead with an AWS key-value database: Amazon DynamoDB. There are many benefits of DynamoDB that we get out of the box, such as horizontal scaling, infrastructure management with no worry about scaling up read/write replicas, TTL configuration, and DynamoDB streams for analytics.

这些查询模式关系型和非关系型数据库都能解决，你可以基于既有经验选择。如果选择关系型数据库部署，我们建议从一开始就采用逻辑分区策略。在本章语境下，我们选用一个 AWS 键值数据库：Amazon DynamoDB。DynamoDB 有许多开箱即用的好处，例如水平扩缩、无需操心扩缩读/写副本的基础设施管理、TTL 配置，以及用于分析的 DynamoDB streams。

DynamoDB scales horizontally based on customer-configured capacity mode. Begin with the on-demand capacity mode to figure out traffic patterns and then migrate to the provisioned mode if the traffic is predictable. The system can experience throttling issues with both on-demand and provisioned, with autoscaling capacity modes for spiky workloads. Preplanning your capacity is helpful in resolving throttling with provisioned mode, and throttling issues are automatically recovered for on-demand capacity mode. There is also an account-level quota of 40,000 RCUs and WCUs for on-demand; this can be increased by raising a quota increase request on the AWS Console.
DynamoDB 基于客户配置的容量模式水平扩缩。先从 on-demand 容量模式入手摸清流量模式，如果流量可预测再迁移到 provisioned 模式。on-demand 和 provisioned 都可能遇到限流问题，针对尖峰工作负载有自动扩缩容量模式。预先规划容量有助于在 provisioned 模式下解决限流，而 on-demand 容量模式下的限流问题会自动恢复。on-demand 在账户级别还有 40,000 RCU 和 WCU 的配额；可以在 AWS 控制台提交配额提升申请来增加。

We can define the DynamoDB partition key and sort key as:

我们可以把 DynamoDB 分区键和排序键定义为：

Partition key = {short URL}
Sort key = SU
Page 390

We can skip defining sort key in the preceding schema because sort key is always a constant string. A constant is suggested because it helps store other entries (apart from long URL mapping) in DynamoDB with partition key as short URL. We’ll require GSI for retrieving all URLs created by a user, and we can use the following schema for the same:

我们可以在上述 schema 中省略定义排序键，因为排序键始终是一个常量字符串。建议用常量，是因为它有助于在 DynamoDB 中以短 URL 为分区键存储其他条目（除长 URL 映射之外）。我们需要 GSI 来检索某个用户创建的所有 URL，为此可以使用以下 schema：

Partition key = {userId}
Sort key = u#{timestamp}

The timestamp is included in the sort key to help with retrieving the URLs in a particular time frame. Now, let’s discuss the choice of database for the KGS.

timestamp 被包含在排序键中，以帮助检索特定时间范围内的 URL。现在我们讨论 KGS 的数据库选择。

KGS. The ID-generation logic is dependent on the ticket servers. Additionally, the KGS should keep some IDs in the buffer to serve the queries faster—but how many IDs should be in the buffer? The logic could be as simple as keeping 10,000 IDs in the buffer, and the number can be tuned based on application traffic. We can utilize an in-memory data store for this purpose, such as Amazon ElastiCache with Redis or Memcached flavor. Redis lists are one way to store IDs.

KGS。ID 生成逻辑依赖于 ticket 服务器。此外，KGS 应在缓冲区中保留一些 ID 以更快地服务查询——但缓冲区中应放多少个 ID？逻辑可以简单到在缓冲区中保留 10,000 个 ID，这个数字可以根据应用流量调优。我们可以为此使用内存数据存储，例如采用 Redis 或 Memcached 引擎的 Amazon ElastiCache。Redis list 是存储 ID 的一种方式。

The KGS doesn’t keep an audit history of which IDs are returned to the URL shortener service at particular instances, and we don’t have that requirement either. This can be built in if needed, and a cache store will be facilitated on top of a configured persistent data store.

KGS 不保留在哪些时刻把哪些 ID 返回给短链接服务的审计历史，我们也没有这个需求。如果需要可以再加，缓存存储将在一个已配置的持久数据存储之上提供。

We’ve discussed the individual components and how the system will operate to serve the requirements. The business aspects of the application are important as well; we want to eventually earn money from our systems. Some examples for revenue generation could be offering URL analytics or a custom URL domain for paid users. Analytics in itself is a big portion of the URL shortener system; the entire end-to-end analytics pipeline is not in the scope of this book. But in the next section, we’ll shed some light on how custom domain support can be built into the system.

我们已经讨论了各个组件以及系统将如何运作以满足需求。应用的业务方面也很重要；我们最终想从系统中赚钱。创收的一些例子可以是向付费用户提供 URL 分析或自定义 URL 域名。分析本身是短链接系统的一大部分；整条端到端分析管道不在本书范围内。但下一节我们将简要说明如何把自定义域名支持构建到系统中。

Custom Domain Support

One of the requirements of the system is to build an extensible system that can expose the APIs to third-party clients—in short, a multitenant system. For example, assume that Google Drive leverages Bitly services to shorten URLs, but Google wants to share custom Google short URLs with users rather than Bitly short URLs. Enabling custom domain support in the system is somewhat similar to maintaining multiple URL shortener systems, each with different domain names. The important point to consider here is whether the system has virtual (or logical) separation or

系统的需求之一是构建一个可扩展的系统，能向第三方客户端暴露 API——简而言之，一个多租户系统。例如，假设 Google Drive 利用 Bitly 服务缩短 URL，但 Google 想与用户分享自定义的 Google 短 URL，而不是 Bitly 短 URL。在系统中启用自定义域名支持，有点类似于维护多个短链接系统，每个都有不同域名。这里要考虑的重要一点是：系统是做虚拟（或逻辑）隔离，还是

Page 391

physical separation. Physical separation means deploying multiple systems in parallel, each serving a specific domain, and virtual separation means the same system caters to all the clients, with internal code separation or configurations.

物理隔离。物理隔离意味着并行部署多个系统，每个服务一个特定域名；虚拟隔离意味着同一个系统服务所有客户端，通过内部代码分离或配置来区分。

Designing and building multitenant systems requires an extensive thought process on system expectations. This section captures a simplistic version of the thought process.
设计和构建多租户系统需要对系统期望做大量思考。本节呈现的是该思考过程的一个简化版本。

Let’s try to solve this via a single DynamoDB table, which maintains the mappings of short URLs to long URLs. DynamoDB requires a partition key and sort key as part of the primary key, so the system defines:

我们尝试通过单个 DynamoDB 表来解决这个问题，该表维护短 URL 到长 URL 的映射。DynamoDB 要求主键中包含分区键和排序键，因此系统定义：

Partition key = {short URL}
Sort key = {tenant ID}

The tenant ID is an identification useful for figuring out different tenants (systems onboarded to the URL shortener system). The short URL is created via an API call by the onboarded system, so it is expected to pass the tenant ID as part of the request. The tenant ID can be created when the system is onboarded, or this can be figured out based on credentials used by the system in the API call. On the get call as well, the tenant ID can be derived based on the domain being accessed. The key in the cache store should be created with a combination of short URL and tenant ID for easy retrievals.

tenant ID 是一个标识，用于弄清不同租户（接入短链接系统的系统）。短 URL 由接入系统通过 API 调用创建，因此预期它会把 tenant ID 作为请求的一部分传入。tenant ID 可以在系统接入时创建，也可以根据系统在 API 调用中使用的凭证弄清。在 get 调用时，也可以根据被访问的域名推导出 tenant ID。缓存存储中的键应使用短 URL 和 tenant ID 的组合来创建，以便检索。

We can definitely create different tables per tenant, but a careful decision should be made based on the number of onboarded systems and their scale of operations. We can take a hybrid approach, often referred to as cell-based architecture. Each cell is responsible for serving a set of onboarded tenants, and the system maintains the mapping for which cell serves a particular tenant. Cells can operate independently because they don’t share the data between them. Another thing to consider in this architecture is load balancing between the cells; one cell might just onboard a single tenant, but another cell might include 10 tenants, depending on the scale requirements.

我们当然可以为每个租户创建不同的表，但应根据接入系统的数量及其运营规模谨慎决策。我们可以采用一种混合方式，通常称为基于 cell 的架构。每个 cell 负责服务一组接入租户，系统维护哪个 cell 服务哪个租户的映射。各 cell 可以独立运行，因为它们之间不共享数据。这种架构中另一件要考虑的事是 cell 之间的负载均衡；一个 cell 可能只接入一个租户，而另一个 cell 可能包含 10 个租户，取决于规模需求。

We have discussed multiple components and considerations for the URL shortener system. Now, let’s combine the components so that they work together, and discuss the launch of the product on the AWS cloud.

我们已经讨论了短链接系统的多个组件和注意事项。现在我们把这些组件组合起来让它们协同工作，并讨论产品在 AWS 云上的上线。

Launching the System on AWS

Refer to Figure 14-4 to review the entire system design. In these sections, we’ll discuss deploying this proposed system architecture on the AWS cloud. We’ll start with Day 0 architecture and use AWS services that are easy to deploy and require less expertise. Then, we’ll move on to scaling the architecture.

回顾图 14-4 查看整个系统设计。在本节中，我们将讨论把这个拟议的系统架构部署到 AWS 云上。我们从 Day 0 架构开始，使用易于部署、所需专业知识较少的 AWS 服务。然后我们转向架构的扩缩。

To simplify the diagrams, the services introduced in our system design diagrams may not include a load balancer or API gateway to front the application. You can always assume that the service includes an LB or any similar component to distribute load into multiple instances of the application.
为简化图示，我们系统设计图中引入的服务可能没有包含在应用前端的负载均衡器或 API 网关。你可以始终假设该服务包含一个 LB 或任何类似组件，把负载分发到应用的多个实例。

Day Zero Architecture

As mentioned, the system should be designed based on the Make It Work, Make It Right, Make It Fast principle, and thinking of those potential 10 million users from the start is not worth it. Day 0 and Day N architecture is a general paradigm followed in Part III. AWS presented a series of sessions (2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023) as part of AWS re:Invent, and we want to extract the recommended guidelines and strategies for you to follow to scale from the first user to more than 10 million users.

如前所述，系统应基于 Make It Work、Make It Right、Make It Fast 原则来设计，从一开始就想着那潜在的一千万用户并不值得。Day 0 和 Day N 架构是第三部分遵循的通用范式。AWS 在 AWS re:Invent 上呈现了一系列演讲（2013、2014、2015、2016、2017、2018、2019、2022、2023），我们想提炼出推荐的准则和策略，供你遵循，从第一个用户扩缩到超过一千万用户。

The general idea is to start with a monolithic application deployed on an EC2 machine with all the components, such as the web server, application execution logic, and database, as shown in Figure 14-6.

总体思路是：从一个部署在 EC2 机器上的单体应用开始，包含所有组件，例如 Web 服务器、应用执行逻辑和数据库，如图 14-6 所示。

This works well for a very few number of users as you roll out the application for experimentation and gather feedback. There are a couple of issues associated with this architecture that should be addressed as the system starts receiving more traffic:

当你把应用推出做实验并收集反馈时，这对于非常少的用户数是可行的。随着系统开始接收更多流量，这个架构有几个问题需要解决：

  • This is a single application doing everything. It’s recommended to avoid putting too many eggs in one basket in order to avoid disruption.
    这是一个包揽一切的单一应用。为避免中断，建议不要把太多鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。
Page 393
  • This has a single point of failure; if the EC2 instance goes down, the application is not available, and user state stored in the database is lost.
    它有单点故障；如果 EC2 实例宕机，应用就不可用，存储在数据库中的用户状态也会丢失。

A few suggestions to improve the architecture are to separate out the database (with a primary and standby instance) and introduce at least two EC2 instances behind an ELB spread across AZs for handling the failover, as shown in Figure 14-7.

改进架构的几个建议是：把数据库单独拆出来（带一个主实例和一个备实例），并在跨 AZ 的 ELB 后面引入至少两个 EC2 实例以处理故障转移，如图 14-7 所示。

Spreading the EC2 instances and database instances across multiple AZs makes the architecture more resilient and prevents data loss and downtime. As the user base grows further—say that more than 10,000 customers are accessing the platform regularly—the load on the EC2 instances as well as the database also grows, making them less performant. We can follow these recommendations to scale out the architecture further:

把 EC2 实例和数据库实例跨多个 AZ 分布，使架构更有弹性，防止数据丢失和宕机。随着用户群进一步增长——比如超过一万个客户定期访问平台——EC2 实例和数据库上的负载也增长，使它们性能下降。我们可以遵循以下建议进一步横向扩缩架构：

Autoscaling. Introduce autoscaling for EC2 instances. Autoscaling ensures that instances are automatically added or removed based on the traffic without manual intervention.

自动扩缩（Autoscaling）。为 EC2 实例引入自动扩缩。自动扩缩确保根据流量自动增加或移除实例，无需人工干预。

Database read replicas. The number of read requests (get a long URL for a short URL) are far greater than the number of write requests (short URL creation). Adding read replicas to the database offloads the load from the primary database instance and distributes the load. The primary instance can focus on the write operations, and all the read traffic can be served by the read replicas in the cluster.

数据库读副本。读请求（根据短 URL 取长 URL）的数量远大于写请求（短 URL 创建）的数量。给数据库添加读副本可以把负载从主数据库实例上卸载下来并分布负载。主实例可以专注于写操作，所有读流量可以由集群中的读副本服务。

Page 394

Caching. There are a few URLs that are heavily accessed, so it doesn’t make sense to hit the database for the same query again and again. The system can be further optimized by introducing a caching layer in front of the read replicas. The system first checks for short URL mapping in the cache and moves to checking the entry in the database if that is not present. Appropriate expiration policies and cache invalidation strategies (see Chapter 4) should ensure that URLs that are not frequently accessed are moved out of the cache and that data in the cache is fresh and relevant.

缓存（Caching）。有少数 URL 被大量访问，因此反复对同一查询打数据库没有意义。通过在读副本前引入缓存层，可以进一步优化系统。系统先在缓存中查找短 URL 映射，如果不存在再去数据库中查条目。恰当的过期策略和缓存失效策略（见第 4 章）应确保不常访问的 URL 被移出缓存，且缓存中的数据是新鲜、相关的。

The architecture in Figure 14-7 can be improved by integrating these suggestions, as shown in Figure 14-8.

通过整合这些建议，图 14-7 中的架构可以得到改进，如图 14-8 所示。

We should continuously evaluate the nature of services we’re using. Multiple fully managed solutions are available in the AWS cloud (such as Amazon RDS or Amazon Aurora), and we can choose one based on our expertise and the amount of operational overload our organization can bear.

我们应持续评估所用服务的性质。AWS 云上有多种全托管方案（例如 Amazon RDS 或 Amazon Aurora），我们可以基于自己的专业知识和组织能承受的运维负担来选择其一。

Expecting further growth on the system, we can move the caching layer closer to customers by introducing a CDN (such as Amazon CloudFront). The more frequently

预期系统会进一步增长，我们可以通过引入 CDN（例如 Amazon CloudFront）把缓存层移得离客户更近。访问更频繁的

Page 395

accessed short URLs can be directly served from CloudFront instead of hitting the backend servers with the request. CloudFront can also be used to serve any static content for faster load times, such as frontend website components like images, CSS, and JavaScript.

短 URL 可以直接由 CloudFront 服务，而不必把请求打到后端服务器。CloudFront 还可以用于服务任何静态内容以加快加载时间，例如前端网站组件，如图片、CSS 和 JavaScript。

AWS cloud has evolved over the years and has simplified the developer experience to launch products without the need for too much expertise. With so many managed services and serverless offerings available, application deployment has become much easier, with very little to zero maintenance overhead.

AWS 云多年来不断演进，简化了开发者上线产品的体验，无需太多专业知识。有了这么多托管服务和 serverless 服务，应用部署变得容易得多，维护开销极少甚至为零。

A simple software application generally involves three components (or tiers): the frontend, the backend, and the database. For the frontend tier, AWS offers Amplify for building web and mobile applications. AWS Amplify reduces the go-to-market to a large extent by removing a lot of operational overhead with features like authentication, analytics, and push notifications. See the AWS documentation for a full list of features.

一个简单的软件应用通常涉及三个组件（或层）：前端、后端和数据库。对于前端层，AWS 提供 Amplify 用于构建 Web 和移动应用。AWS Amplify 通过认证、分析和推送通知等特性消除大量运维开销，在很大程度上缩短了上市时间。完整特性列表见 AWS 文档。

There are a wide array of compute options on AWS, as discussed in Chapter 11, and we’ll choose the simplest deployment option for the Day 0 architecture. One of the options is using AWS Lambda to host the application logic without the worry of infrastructure management, as shown in Figure 14-9.

如第 11 章所讨论，AWS 上有广泛的计算选项，我们为 Day 0 架构选择最简单的部署选项。其中一个选项是使用 AWS Lambda 托管应用逻辑，而无需操心基础设施管理，如图 14-9 所示。

As we’re proposing to use Lambda for operations on the URL, we can choose to deploy separate Lambdas based on APIs or a single Lambda handling all the

由于我们提议使用 Lambda 对 URL 做操作，我们可以选择按 API 部署单独的 Lambda，或用单个 Lambda 处理所有

Page 396

operations. Keep separate Lambdas for the different APIs for clear segregation in the application logic. This also helps with moving these API functions to different compute options in the future if needed. The diagram includes some additional services, such as Amazon CloudWatch for monitoring, Amazon Cognito and AWS IAM for authentication and authorization, Amazon VPC to launch the resources, and AWS Certificate Manager for SSL/TLS certificate management.

操作。为不同 API 保留单独的 Lambda，以便在应用逻辑中清晰隔离。这也有助于将来在需要时把这些 API 函数迁移到不同的计算选项。图中还包含一些附加服务，例如用于监控的 Amazon CloudWatch、用于认证和授权的 Amazon Cognito 和 AWS IAM、用于启动资源的 Amazon VPC，以及用于 SSL/TLS 证书管理的 AWS Certificate Manager。

Another approach for application deployment can be to use the AWS App Runner service to fully manage deployment of containerized web applications or backend API services, as shown in Figure 14-10. App Runner launches all the resources in the VPC managed by AWS itself.

应用部署的另一种方式是使用 AWS App Runner 服务来全托管容器化 Web 应用或后端 API 服务的部署，如图 14-10 所示。App Runner 在由 AWS 自己管理的 VPC 中启动所有资源。

AWS App Runner abstracts all the components, and customers just need to focus on application development. It is built with a combination of ECS Fargate, autoscaling, ELB, and ECR, and it supports Python, Node.js, Java, Go, Rails, PHP, and .Net as language runtimes. Customers are required to specify a GitHub source code repository or an ECR image, and App Runner takes all the responsibility of application deployment as ECS Fargate tasks. The App Runner CreateService API returns a secure URL that can be used to access the service APIs.

AWS App Runner 抽象掉了所有组件，客户只需专注于应用开发。它由 ECS Fargate、自动扩缩、ELB 和 ECR 组合构建，支持 Python、Node.js、Java、Go、Rails、PHP 和 .Net 作为语言运行时。客户只需指定一个 GitHub 源代码仓库或一个 ECR 镜像，App Runner 就以 ECS Fargate 任务的形式承担应用部署的全部责任。App Runner CreateService API 返回一个安全 URL，可用于访问服务 API。

Looking at the overall architecture, the user request is routed to the NLB after domain resolution via Route 53 and then forwarded to an application L7 request router, which further redirects to ECS Fargate tasks. We also added Amazon ElastiCache in the diagram to showcase the connectivity between the AWS App Runner VPC and the customer-managed VPC. ElastiCache is helpful for caching the most frequent get calls for mapping short URLs to long URLs and reduces the load on persistent databases with an improvement in the query performance. App Runner can also be configured to accept traffic via a customer-managed personal VPC (a private VPC in an AWS account) by using the AWS PrivateLink endpoint.

纵观整体架构，用户请求经 Route 53 做域名解析后被路由到 NLB，然后转发到一个应用层 L7 请求路由器，再进一步重定向到 ECS Fargate 任务。我们还在图中加入了 Amazon ElastiCache，以展示 AWS App Runner VPC 与客户管理 VPC 之间的连通性。ElastiCache 有助于缓存最频繁的 get 调用（短 URL 到长 URL 的映射），并在提升查询性能的同时降低持久数据库上的负载。App Runner 还可以配置为通过使用 AWS PrivateLink endpoint，经由客户管理的个人 VPC（某个 AWS 账户中的私有 VPC）接收流量。

Page 397

There is always the possibility that the Day 0 architecture system will face some bottlenecks as it serves more user traffic and features, so let’s now think about how we can scale.

Day 0 架构系统在服务更多用户流量和特性时，总是有可能遇到一些瓶颈，因此现在我们思考如何扩缩。

Scaling to Millions and Beyond

With our Day 0 architecture, we try to launch the product without planning too far ahead and choose the technologies we’re most familiar with instead of trying out something very new that will include a learning curve. In short, time to market should be minimal. Let’s consider the example of a compute platform. There are multiple options, such as AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2, Amazon ECS, and Amazon EKS. If you’re most comfortable with Amazon EKS and have prior experience with it, choose that option as a compute platform to start.

在 Day 0 架构下，我们尽量不过度规划地推出产品，选择我们最熟悉的技术，而不是尝试非常新、会带来学习曲线的东西。简而言之，上市时间应最短。我们以计算平台为例。有多个选项，例如 AWS Lambda、Amazon EC2、Amazon ECS 和 Amazon EKS。如果你对 Amazon EKS 最顺手并有既往经验，就选它作为起步的计算平台。

We’ll now dig deeper into the architectures diagrammed in Figures 14-9 and 14-10 to identify any issues and address them so as to ensure the system’s high availability. Let’s start our discussion with observability and then move on to the storage and compute counterparts.

我们现在更深入地考察图 14-9 和图 14-10 中绘出的架构，找出任何问题并加以解决，以确保系统高可用。我们从可观测性开始讨论，然后转向存储和计算对应部分。

Observability

We discussed the importance of metrics and alarms in Chapter 12. To identify bottlenecks, we recommend setting proper metrics and alarms via tools like Amazon CloudWatch and AWS X-Ray. The AWS X-Ray service helps with request tracing in a distributed system architecture as well as figuring out which component is taking more time in processing. As we identify specific components causing issues in the overall system, we can dig deeper to figure out a resolution. Alarms play an important role in identifying critical issues; example alarms could be LONG_URL_REDIRECTION_ERRORS (an alarm is activated if errors are greater than 10 per minute for a continuous five minutes) or SHORT_URL_CREATION_FAILURE (an alarm is activated if the short URL creation API fails above the defined threshold).

我们在第 12 章讨论了指标和告警的重要性。为识别瓶颈，我们推荐通过 Amazon CloudWatch 和 AWS X-Ray 等工具设置恰当的指标和告警。AWS X-Ray 服务有助于在分布式系统架构中做请求追踪，并弄清哪个组件在处理上花了更多时间。当我们识别出导致整体系统问题的特定组件时，可以更深入地找出解决方案。告警在识别关键问题上扮演重要角色；示例告警可以是 LONG_URL_REDIRECTION_ERRORS（如果每分钟错误数连续五分钟大于 10 就触发告警）或 SHORT_URL_CREATION_FAILURE（如果短 URL 创建 API 失败率超过定义阈值就触发告警）。

Storage layer

The system is using Amazon DynamoDB as a data store to maintain the URL mappings. We don’t have to worry about the scaling capabilities of DynamoDB as it is managed completely by AWS. To begin with, we can utilize on-demand capacity

系统使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据存储来维护 URL 映射。我们无需担心 DynamoDB 的扩缩能力，因为它完全由 AWS 管理。一开始，我们可以利用 on-demand 容量

Page 398

mode, and as we figure out traffic patterns, provisioned mode with autoscaling can be used to reduce costs. The application can be launched in multiple AWS regions, and DynamoDB global tables can be used to ensure that data is replicated across the regions. A key consideration for global tables is that there is approximately one second of replication lag between two or more regions, so it is possible that a short URL might not be available in another region as soon as it is created.

模式，等我们摸清流量模式后，可以用带自动扩缩的 provisioned 模式来降低成本。应用可以在多个 AWS 区域启动，并使用 DynamoDB global tables 确保数据跨区域复制。global tables 的一个关键考虑是：两个或更多区域之间约有一秒的复制延迟，因此短 URL 在创建后可能无法立刻在另一个区域可用。

At re:Invent 2024, Amazon DynamoDB announced it was launching support for strong consistency reads in multiregion global tables. The read and write latency tends to be higher compared to eventual consistency but can be useful if strong consistency is a business requirement.
在 re:Invent 2024 上，Amazon DynamoDB 宣布将在多区域 global tables 中支持强一致性读取。与最终一致性相比，读和写延迟往往更高，但如果强一致性是业务需求，它会很有用。

For URLs generated by popular users, the read traffic can be really huge, so there is no point in serving all read queries directly from the database. DynamoDB guarantees single-digit millisecond latency on direct key operations, but to make it even more seamless and bring down latency to microseconds, we can add a caching layer on top of DynamoDB, such as Amazon ElastiCache or Amazon DAX, to improve read performance. The improvement in latency also depends on network latency. Realistically, it could be around 5−10 ms with caching solutions incorporated. The caching layer on top of the database also helps reduce database load and optimize costs.

对于热门用户生成的 URL，读流量可能非常巨大，因此没有理由让所有读查询都直接打数据库。DynamoDB 在直接键操作上保证个位数毫秒延迟，但为了让它更无缝、把延迟降到微秒级，我们可以在 DynamoDB 之上加一层缓存，例如 Amazon ElastiCache 或 Amazon DAX，以提升读性能。延迟的改善也取决于网络延迟。现实地说，加入缓存方案后大约在 5–10 ms。数据库之上的缓存层还有助于降低数据库负载并优化成本。

An key consideration for any system you’re designing with DynamoDB as your storage option is justifying the requirement for caching with DAX or ElastiCache—which one should you use? The ideal choice may be DAX since it is specifically built for DynamoDB to improve query read performance, but ElastiCache may be a better choice if the queries are already being served by it for any other use case or if you’re more familiar with the technology. This reduces integration effort into newer technology, saving implementation bandwidth. It is always a good idea to perform benchmarking tests to compare two technologies to support a technical decision because, in the end, we need a combination of low latency and a cost-efficient solution. For increased traffic, we recommend distributed cache (such as Redis in cluster mode) to spread out the workload on the cache and increase response times.

对于任何以 DynamoDB 为存储选项设计的系统，一个关键考虑是：论证用 DAX 还是 ElastiCache 做缓存的需求——应该用哪一个？理想选择可能是 DAX，因为它专为 DynamoDB 提升查询读性能而构建；但如果查询已经由 ElastiCache 服务于其他用例、或你对该技术更熟悉，ElastiCache 可能是更好的选择。这减少了集成新技术的工作量，节省了实现带宽。做基准测试来比较两种技术以支撑技术决策，始终是个好主意，因为归根结底我们需要低延迟与高性价比方案的结合。对于增长的流量，我们推荐分布式缓存（例如集群模式的 Redis），把负载分散到缓存上并提高响应速度。

The idea of caching holds true for any database type for serving frequent queries. In addition to these, we should reevaluate the data-access patterns and the possibility of improvement of (for example) slow database queries (or API requests) and query timeout handling. Database federation and sharding also become important with increasing scale in the case of relational databases.
缓存的思想对任何类型数据库服务频繁查询都成立。除此之外，我们应重新评估数据访问模式，以及（例如）缓慢数据库查询（或 API 请求）和查询超时处理的改进可能。对于关系型数据库，随着规模增长，数据库联邦和分片也变得重要。
Page 399

Compute layer

For the compute layer, we preferred AWS Lambda in Figure 14-9 and AWS App Runner in Figure 14-10 to avoid the setup of Amazon EC2 and reduce operational burden, but can Lambda or App Runner scale to millions of customers? Lambda automatically scales per traffic requirements without any customer intervention. However, the problem we might face is p100 latency, which can increase from time to time due to cold-start issues. We discussed a couple of solutions to overcome the cold-start problem in Chapter 11, such as provisioned concurrency, which can help address the latency bottleneck.

对于计算层，我们在图 14-9 中偏好 AWS Lambda、在图 14-10 中偏好 AWS App Runner，以避免搭建 Amazon EC2 并降低运维负担，但 Lambda 或 App Runner 能扩缩到数百万客户吗？Lambda 根据流量需求自动扩缩，无需客户干预。然而，我们可能面临的问题是 p100 延迟，它会因冷启动问题时而升高。我们在第 11 章讨论过几个克服冷启动问题的方案，例如预置并发，它有助于解决延迟瓶颈。

App Runner allows a maximum of 25 instances per service and a maximum of 200 concurrent requests per instance, leading to 5,000 concurrent requests per service. See the documentation on AWS limits for updated information on service quotas. The limit on the number of requests can become a bottleneck per our scale considerations in “System Scale” on page 357.

App Runner 每个服务最多允许 25 个实例，每个实例最多 200 个并发请求，即每个服务 5,000 个并发请求。服务配额的最新信息见 AWS 限额文档。按我们在第 357 页“系统规模”中的规模考虑，请求数量上限可能成为瓶颈。

Concurrent requests per instance differ from requests per second. Essentially, an instance can serve 10 requests in a second if an API takes an execution time of 100 ms. We recommend optimization of application code along with keeping an eye on managed services quotas.
每个实例的并发请求数不同于每秒请求数。本质上，如果一个 API 的执行时间为 100 ms，一个实例一秒可以服务 10 个请求。我们建议在优化应用代码的同时，密切关注托管服务配额。

A point to consider here is that the limits can be increased in the future by AWS, and this should not prevent us from launching the first version of the product. AWS cloud offerings and open source solutions evolve, and cloud providers innovate on the behalf of their customers, so it is possible that App Runner will be able to support much higher scale with lower cost in the future. Remember that no architecture is considered final, and we can always reevaluate and reiterate in case of any bottlenecks, as shown in the software lifecycle in Figure 14-11.

这里要考虑的一点是：这些限额将来可能被 AWS 提高，这不应阻碍我们上线产品的第一个版本。AWS 云服务和开源方案在演进，云提供商代表客户做创新，因此 App Runner 将来有可能以更低成本支持高得多的规模。记住，没有架构是最终版的，遇到任何瓶颈我们总可以重新评估、反复迭代，如图 14-11 中的软件生命周期所示。

Here are a few things to consider to scale the compute part of your system:

下面是扩缩系统计算部分时要考虑的几件事：

Page 400
  • Consider migrating to unmanaged versions of services, such as moving to Amazon ECS EC2 from Amazon ECS Fargate, to have more control over hardware configurations. This can prove to be a cheaper alternative in the long run when operating at a huge scale.
    考虑迁移到非托管版本的服务，例如从 Amazon ECS Fargate 迁移到 Amazon ECS EC2，以对硬件配置有更多控制。在超大规模运营时，这长期来看可能是更便宜的替代方案。
  • The system will have autoscaling in place to handle any increased load during peak times. The ASGs should be in different AZs to withstand AZ downtimes. In the case of managed systems like ECS Fargate, AWS takes care of deploying the system into multiple AZs to ensure availability. Take this into consideration if you’re managing the systems.
    系统将配有自动扩缩，以应对高峰时段任何增加的负载。ASG 应位于不同 AZ 以承受 AZ 宕机。对于 ECS Fargate 这样的托管系统，AWS 负责把系统部署到多个 AZ 以确保可用性。如果你在管理系统，请把这一点考虑在内。

Now, let’s incorporate all these concepts and present the final architecture on AWS.

现在我们把所有这些概念整合起来，呈现 AWS 上的最终架构。

Day N Architecture

We’re using a single AWS account to host all the services in the architecture—this can be evolved further as necessary to host services in different AWS accounts or to take any other approach of account separation, as we discussed in the section “Getting Started with AWS” on page 222 in Chapter 9. Note that using multiple AWS accounts can increase the cost of data flow across the services, and shared databases can become difficult to manage, though it can make the responsibility of each account simpler with clear boundaries.

我们用单个 AWS 账户托管架构中的所有服务——这可以根据需要进一步演进，把服务托管到不同 AWS 账户，或采用任何其他账户隔离方式，如我们在第 9 章第 222 页“开始使用 AWS”一节所讨论。注意，使用多个 AWS 账户会增加服务间数据流的成本，共享数据库也会变得难以管理，不过它能让每个账户的职责边界更清晰、更简单。

Expanding the discussion from Chapter 9, another degree of isolation is at the VPC level. If all the applications are created in the same AWS account, are they present in the same VPC or different VPCs? If they are in the same VPC, are they hosted in the same subnet or in different subnets? The resources should definitely be launched in different subnets (even for a single application) to ensure high availability across the AZs. Launching all applications in a single VPC helps reduce network costs but requires extra care with managing the security of interapplication communications. The rules can be managed by NACLs, and we recommend maintaining a limited number of rules. The rules are evaluated one by one, and a large number of rules can compromise network efficiency by taking more time to evaluate (as compared to all rules being evaluated in parallel).

把第 9 章的讨论展开，另一层隔离在 VPC 级别。如果所有应用都在同一个 AWS 账户中创建，它们是在同一个 VPC 还是不同 VPC？如果在同一个 VPC，它们是托管在同一个子网还是不同子网？资源绝对应当（即使是单个应用）启动在不同子网中，以确保跨 AZ 的高可用。把所有应用启动在单个 VPC 中有助于降低网络成本，但需要格外小心管理应用间通信的安全。规则可以由 NACL 管理，我们建议维护有限数量的规则。规则是逐条评估的，大量规则会因评估耗时更长（相比所有规则并行评估）而损害网络效率。

Our URL shortener system architecture can include five microservices for serving simplistic functional requirements:

我们的短链接系统架构可以包含五个微服务，以服务简化的功能需求：

Frontend service. Receives the customer traffic and redirects to specific service VPCs per the operation.

前端服务（Frontend service）。接收客户流量，并按操作重定向到特定服务 VPC。

URL creator service. Creates URLs.

URL 创建服务（URL creator service）。创建 URL。

Page 401

URL reader service. Redirects from short URLs to long URLs.

URL 读取服务（URL reader service）。把短 URL 重定向到长 URL。

KGS. Generates unique keys to be used as short URLs.

KGS。生成用作短 URL 的唯一密钥。

Data management service. A thin layer of CRUD APIs between the databases and services in the architecture. This is introduced into the architecture because the DynamoDB and ElastiCache are accessible to two systems.

数据管理服务（Data management service）。架构中数据库与服务之间的一层薄薄的 CRUD API。把它引入架构是因为 DynamoDB 和 ElastiCache 会被两个系统访问。

Evaluate the architecture from time to time to figure out if the application should be split further (microservice architecture) to address the increasing scale.

不时评估架构，以弄清是否应进一步拆分应用（微服务架构）来应对不断增长的规模。

Returning to the URL shortener system design, we are looking at a huge scale, so deploying the applications in separate VPCs should ensure proper isolation. Another architecture pattern followed by organizations is deploying multiple microservices on the same EKS cluster (in the same VPC). This makes sense at a limited scale, but in the context of Day N architecture, we recommend using separate EKS clusters for service deployments for complete resource isolation (revisit Chapter 7 for Kubernetes architecture).

回到短链接系统设计，我们面对的是巨大规模，因此把应用部署在不同 VPC 中应确保恰当的隔离。组织遵循的另一种架构模式是把多个微服务部署在同一个 EKS 集群（同一 VPC）上。这在有限规模下是合理的，但在 Day N 架构语境下，我们推荐使用单独的 EKS 集群部署服务，以实现完全的资源隔离（Kubernetes 架构回顾第 7 章）。

It is not always true that the AWS cloud components can introduce bottlenecks with increasing scale—it could also be the application code introducing bugs and bottlenecks into the system. For example, the DynamoDB key schema worked well on Day 0 but is not performing very well with increased traffic. We can use tools like Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer and Amazon DevOps Guru to identify potential bottlenecks and then work toward resolution.
AWS 云组件并非总是会在规模增长时引入瓶颈——也可能是应用代码给系统引入了 bug 和瓶颈。例如，DynamoDB 键 schema 在 Day 0 时工作良好，但在流量增长后性能不佳。我们可以使用 Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer 和 Amazon DevOps Guru 等工具识别潜在瓶颈，然后着手解决。

图 14-12 展示了短链接系统架构的最终图景。

Here are some additional points to keep in mind, which we left out of the diagram to make it cleaner:

下面是一些要牢记的附加点，为使图更简洁我们没有把它们画进去：

  • The public subnet is needed in the frontend service for internet connectivity via IGW or putting resources such as bastion host.
    前端服务中需要公有子网，以便通过 IGW 连接互联网，或放置堡垒主机等资源。
  • The services residing in different VPCs require a mechanism to connect them to one another. AWS Transit Gateways provides bidirectional communication between the VPCs; AWS PrivateLinks provides unidirectional communication. The CIDR blocks of the VPCs should not overlap in the case of Transit Gateways, but PrivateLink doesn’t take this into consideration.
    位于不同 VPC 中的服务需要一种机制把它们彼此连接起来。AWS Transit Gateway 提供 VPC 之间的双向通信；AWS PrivateLink 提供单向通信。使用 Transit Gateway 时各 VPC 的 CIDR 块不应重叠，但 PrivateLink 不考虑这一点。
  • The microservices also interact with AWS services that are present in our owned VPC. These services should be accessed via PrivateLink instead of NAT gateways. This ensures that the traffic doesn’t go over the internet, which adds to application security and minimizes operation latency. NAT gateway should only be used when an explicit connection to the internet is needed.
    微服务还与我们自有 VPC 中的 AWS 服务交互。这些服务应通过 PrivateLink 而非 NAT 网关访问。这确保流量不经过互联网，从而增强应用安全并最小化操作延迟。NAT 网关只在需要显式连接互联网时使用。
  • Other ways for microservices running on Amazon ECS to establish communication with one another can be via ECS Service Discovery, AWS App Mesh, and ECS Service Connect.
    运行在 Amazon ECS 上的微服务彼此建立通信的其他方式可以是通过 ECS Service Discovery、AWS App Mesh 和 ECS Service Connect。
  • Amazon ElastiCache is used as a caching layer on top of DynamoDB to serve read queries faster. ElastiCache will remove the least used data per the cache eviction policy. We can introduce an additional AWS Lambda function (invoked on a DynamoDB data deletion event) to ensure data is removed from the cache if it is removed from DynamoDB. This can happen in the case of any custom expiration of the short URL by the users. Instead of the Lambda function, we can implement a consumer in the data management service itself that can handle this responsibility.
    Amazon ElastiCache 用作 DynamoDB 之上的缓存层，以更快地服务读查询。ElastiCache 会按缓存淘汰策略移除最少使用的数据。我们可以引入一个额外的 AWS Lambda 函数（在 DynamoDB 数据删除事件上触发），以确保数据在从 DynamoDB 移除时也从缓存中移除。这在用户对短 URL 做自定义过期时可能发生。我们也可以在数据管理服务本身实现一个消费者来承担这个职责，而不用 Lambda 函数。
It’s possible that the DDB entry is not deleted at the exact time mentioned in TTL. Explore alternatives if the deletion should happen at exact time specified.
DDB 条目有可能不会在 TTL 所指定的确切时间被删除。如果删除必须在指定的精确时间发生，请探索替代方案。
  • The architecture presents deployment in a single AWS region. We recommend creating all the infrastructure via code for easy replication to other regions if required. The system resources are deployed in multiple AZs to ensure increased redundancy in case of AZ downtimes.
    图中架构呈现的是在单个 AWS 区域部署。我们推荐通过代码创建所有基础设施，以便在需要时轻松复制到其他区域。系统资源部署在多个 AZ 中，以在 AZ 宕机时确保更高的冗余。
  • The main reason for separating the URL creator service and the URL reader service is the huge difference in traffic patterns. A separate service ensures independent scaling and clear separation of concern.
    把 URL 创建服务和 URL 读取服务分开的主要原因是流量模式的巨大差异。独立服务确保独立扩缩和清晰的关注点分离。
Page 404
  • The system architecture should ensure that the increased traffic is from actual users and throttle any unwanted traffic at the API Gateway or ELB level using AWS services like AWS WAF and AWS Shield or by deploying custom solutions. This can be handled in the frontend service.
    系统架构应确保增长的流量来自真实用户，并在 API Gateway 或 ELB 层使用 AWS WAF 和 AWS Shield 等 AWS 服务、或部署自定义方案来限流任何不需要的流量。这可以在前端服务中处理。

This is not an exhaustive list of issues to take care of while serving customers. We will cover additional topics in the rest of Part III. Take a holistic view of the learnings from Part III when deploying systems in production to ensure high standards.

这并不是服务客户时需要处理问题的穷尽清单。我们将在第三部分剩余章节中覆盖更多主题。在生产环境部署系统时，请通盘考虑第三部分所学，以确保高标准。

Conclusion

We started off Part III with a URL shortener system, which is a popular problem presented at interviews and a system we commonly use in our daily lives. The gist of any new system design is to start with requirement clarifications and system boundaries. You should clearly know what a system is expected to do and what a system will never do—this helps you make better design decisions.

我们以一个短链接系统开启第三部分，它是面试中常见的问题，也是我们日常生活中常用的系统。任何新系统设计的要旨都是从需求澄清和系统边界开始。你应清楚知道一个系统预期做什么、永远不做什么——这帮助你做出更好的设计决策。

Once the requirements and scope of the system are finalized, we move on to identifying the high-level components. The scale a system is supposed to serve is an important factor for identifying these components, along with the business use case. A system operational with 10,000 users might not work the same way with 100,000 users. Table 14-1 summarizes scaling the application architecture from zero users to millions of users.

一旦系统的需求和范围确定，我们就转向识别高层组件。系统要服务的规模是识别这些组件的重要因素，业务用例也是如此。一个在一万用户下运转的系统，在十万用户下可能不再同样工作。表 14-1 总结了把应用架构从零用户扩缩到数百万用户的过程。

We have moved through multiple possible approaches to building a URL shortener service, discussing the pros and cons of each approach along with potential AWS cloud components we can use. We brought in many of the AWS services we discussed in Part II, and we acknowledge that recognizing which one to choose for your specific use case could be difficult. We recommend choosing a technology that will take the minimum time to understand and deploy—down the line, it can be modified or replaced by another technology if needed.

我们走查了构建短链接服务的多种可能方法，讨论了每种方法的利弊以及我们可以使用的潜在 AWS 云组件。我们引入了第二部分讨论过的许多 AWS 服务，我们也承认：要为你的特定用例判断选哪一个可能并不容易。我们推荐选择理解和部署耗时最短的技术——日后如有需要，它可以被修改或替换为另一种技术。

System design is an iterative process, so start small and enhance your systems on the go as needed. Don’t think too far ahead because your priorities may shift after 5 or 10 years. In the next chapter, we’ll design a web crawler and search engine system like Google search using AWS components.

系统设计是一个迭代过程，所以从小处起步，按需随时增强你的系统。不要想得太远，因为你的优先级在 5 年或 10 年后可能会转变。下一章，我们将用 AWS 组件设计一个像 Google 搜索那样的网络爬虫和搜索引擎系统。

Basic monolithic setupThis is the simplest architecture to start with since it consolidates all application components in a single instance.Deploy the entire application stack (web server, application server, and database) on a single server or instance.Low initial complexity and cost, making it easy to develop and deploy for small-scale applications
Set up multi-AZ database for high availabilityEnsuring database availability across multiple AZs provides resilience against data loss and downtime.In AWS, for example, you can set up a multi-AZ database using Amazon RDS, which replicates data automatically to a standby in another AZ.High availability and minimal downtime in the event of a database or AZ failure
Add read replicas to handle increased read trafficAs the application grows, read requests can overload the primary database. Read replicas allow you to offload these requests and distribute the load.Set up read replicas in the same region or in different regions to improve read performance for users in various geographic areas.Enhanced read scalability and database performance by handling read requests separately from write operations
Add caching in front of the databaseDirect database queries for high-traffic or frequently requested data can result in latency and performance degradation. A cache provides faster data access for repeated queries and reduces database strain.Choose a cache solution: implement a distributed cache like Redis or Memcached. Integrate with the application: add logic to check the cache for data before querying the database. Manage the cache: use expiration policies to ensure data freshness.Faster response times, reduced load on the database, and scalability by serving data efficiently
Add multiple EC2 instances and an LB for redundancy and scalingDistributing the application load across multiple instances prevents single points of failure and improves scalability.Deploy multiple EC2 instances and place them behind an LB that routes traffic evenly across these instances.Increased fault tolerance, improved redundancy, and the ability to handle larger volumes of incoming traffic
Implement an ASG for elasticityAutoscaling adjusts the number of running instances according to demand, optimizing resource usage and costs.Define scaling policies based on metrics like CPU utilization, traffic, or custom application metrics.Responsive scaling to meet traffic demand while keeping infrastructure costs manageable
Switch to a managed database service for ease of managementManaging databases can be time intensive, and a managed service like Amazon RDS or Amazon Aurora automates routine tasks, such as backups and scaling.Migrate to a managed database service compatible with your database engine (e.g., MySQL or PostgreSQL).Reduced operational overhead, automated maintenance, and simplified scaling options
Move static content to Amazon S3 to reduce server loadOffloading static assets (e.g., images, CSS, JavaScript) to Amazon S3 frees up application servers and reduces bandwidth costs.Store and serve static files from an S3 bucket, and update application URLs to point to the S3 path for static content.Lower application server load, high availability, and optimized cost for storing and serving static files
Use a CDN for faster content deliveryA CDN improves content load times by caching and delivering static assets from edge locations close to end users.Use Amazon CloudFront or another CDN to cache S3-hosted content and distribute it to a global network of edge locations.Reduced latency, improved load times, and a better user experience, especially for global audiences

表 14-1：从零到数百万用户的扩缩。① 基础单体搭建：最简单，把所有应用组件 consolidated 到单实例；把整个应用栈（Web 服务器、应用服务器、数据库）部署在单台服务器/实例上；初始复杂度和成本低，易于小尺度开发部署。② 搭建多 AZ 数据库以高可用：跨 AZ 确保数据库可用，抗数据丢失和宕机；用 Amazon RDS 搭建多 AZ 数据库，自动同步到另一 AZ 的备库；高可用、故障时宕机最少。③ 加读副本应对读流量增长：随应用增长读请求会压垮主库，读副本可卸载并分布负载；在同区域或跨区域建读副本；读扩缩性和数据库性能提升。④ 数据库前加缓存：高频数据直接查库会导致延迟和性能下降，缓存为重复查询提供更快访问；选 Redis/Memcached 分布式缓存，应用先查缓存再查库，用过期策略保证新鲜；响应更快、库负载降低、可扩缩。⑤ 加多 EC2 实例和 LB：跨实例分发负载防单点、提扩缩性；多实例置于 LB 后均匀分发；容错更强、冗余更好、能扛更大流量。⑥ 实现 ASG 弹性：自动按需求调整实例数；按 CPU、流量等指标定义扩缩策略；弹性响应流量、成本可控。⑦ 转向托管数据库服务：管理库很耗时，RDS/Aurora 自动做备份和扩缩；迁移到兼容你数据库引擎的托管服务；运维开销低、自动维护、扩缩简单。⑧ 静态内容移到 S3：把图片/CSS/JS 卸载到 S3，释放应用服务器、降带宽成本；从 S3 桶存储和服务静态文件，把应用 URL 指向 S3 路径；服务器负载更低、高可用、静态文件存储服务成本优化。⑨ 用 CDN 加速：CDN 从靠近用户的边缘位置缓存和分发静态资源；用 CloudFront 缓存 S3 内容并分发到全球边缘网络；延迟更低、加载更快、全球用户体验更好。⑩ 用 IaC 保证一致性和自动化：Terraform/CloudFormation 以版本可控、可复现方式管理基础设施；用代码定义 EC2、数据库、网络等；可重复搭建、跨开发/预发/生产部署一致环境。⑪ 集中日志和监控：集中式日志监控使主动管理性能、快速定位问题；用 CloudWatch/ELK/Datadog 集中日志和指标；可视性更好、关键问题实时告警、排障调试更高效。⑫ 用分布式缓存应对频繁数据访问：高流量应用中缓存高频但少更新的数据可降库负载和响应时间；实现 Redis/Memcached 分布式缓存，应用先查缓存再查库；响应更快、库负载更低、把高频数据卸载到专用缓存提升扩缩性。⑬ 重构为微服务（长期步骤）：把单体拆成微服务提升灵活性、扩缩性和敏捷度；识别可重构为独立服务的组件（如用户管理或计费）并单独部署；扩缩性更强、资源利用更高效、模块化独立部署使开发周期更快。
